A0_A1.title: Kenji (Japanese 🇯🇵)
A0_A1.visualDescription: Young Japanese man with neat dark hair, friendly smile, wearing a traditional yukata robe during summer festival.

pages.bio: Konnichiwa! I am Kenji. I am Japanese. I live in Tokyo, Japan. My native language is Japanese.
In Japan, we eat delicious sushi and hot ramen! I love green tea and cherry blossom season.

A0_A1.opener: Konnichiwa! What is your nationality and native language?
A0_A1.prompt: Say Kenji's nationality, home country, and favorite food in simple sentences.

A0_A1.title: Sofia (Italian 🇮🇹)
A0_A1.visualDescription: Cheerful Italian woman with brown wavy hair, wearing a sun dress near the Trevi Fountain in Rome.

pages.bio: Ciao! I am Sofia. I am Italian. I come from Rome, Italy. I speak Italian and basic English.
Italy is famous for pizza, pasta, and gelato! I love cooking homemade pasta with fresh basil.

redFlags: ✗ Gets furious if you break spaghetti
✗ Talks with big hand gestures constantly

A0_A1.opener: Ciao! Have you ever visited Italy or tried Italian gelato?
A0_A1.prompt: What country is Sofia from and what is her nationality?

A2.title: Mateo (Mexican 🇲🇽)
A2.visualDescription: Smiley Mexican man in a colorful embroidered shirt, holding street tacos in a vibrant Oaxaca town square.

pages.bio: Hola! I am Mateo from Oaxaca, Mexico. I am proud of my Mexican heritage and rich indigenous culture!
We celebrate Day of the Dead with marigold flowers and enjoy spicy mole and fresh hand-pressed corn tacos.

redFlags: ✗ Claims salsa is 'not spicy' when it burns

A2.opener: Hola! Do you enjoy spicy food and vibrant cultural festivals?
icebreakers: Day of the Dead looks beautiful!
A2.prompt: Describe Mateo's nationality, cultural traditions, and traditional dishes.

A2.title: Freja (Danish 🇩🇰)
A2.visualDescription: Blonde Danish woman riding a bicycle along Nyhavn harbor, wearing a cozy knit sweater.

pages.bio: Hej! My name is Freja. I am Danish, living in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish culture values comfort and 'hygge'.
We ride bicycles everywhere in rain or snow! We love smørrebrød (open rye sandwiches) and candlelight evenings.

redFlags: ✗ Refuses to ride in cars under 5 miles

A2.opener: Hej! Do you prefer cycling around cities or taking cozy café breaks?
A2.prompt: Explain what country Freja is from and describe two key aspects of Danish lifestyle.

B1.title: Amara (Nigerian 🇳🇬)
B1.visualDescription: Radiant Nigerian woman wearing a vibrant patterned Ankara print headwrap and dress in bustling Lagos.

pages.bio: Kedu! I'm Amara, a proud Nigerian from Lagos. Nigeria is a diverse nation with over 250 ethnic groups, rich folklore, and Afrobeats rhythm.
Our celebratory gatherings feature spicy Jollof rice, plantains, and vibrant traditional attire with elaborate Gele headwraps.

greenFlags: ✓ Host legendary dinner parties with Afrobeats playlist
✓ Master of authentic smoky Jollof rice
redFlags: ✗ Will debate Jollof rice superiority for 3 hours
✗ Loud phone conversations at all times

B1.opener: Kedu! How familiar are you with West African gastronomy and global Afrobeats music?
icebreakers: I've heard about the Jollof debate!
B1.prompt: Discuss Amara's Nigerian cultural background, traditions, and musical influence.

B1.title: Aarav (Indian 🇮🇳)
B1.visualDescription: Indian man in a royal blue kurta near Hawa Mahal in Jaipur, holding steaming masala chai.

pages.bio: Namaste! I'm Aarav from Jaipur, India. India is renowned for its pluralistic heritage, architectural marvels, and millennia of history.
Indian hospitality rests on 'Atithi Devo Bhava' (Guest is God). I brew authentic aromatic cardamom masala chai and cook fragrant biryani.

redFlags: ✗ Insists masala chai in tea bags isn't real tea

B1.opener: Namaste! Have you experienced Indian culinary spice blends or historical monuments?
icebreakers: I drink masala chai every day!
B1.prompt: Examine Aarav's Indian nationality, cultural ethos of hospitality, and cuisine.

B2.title: Camille (French 🇫🇷)
B2.visualDescription: Sophisticated French woman wearing a trench coat and beret, seated at a Parisian pavement café with a glass of red wine.

pages.bio: Bonjour. I am Camille from Paris. French identity embodies 'art de vivre'—the subtle intellectual art of living well through literature, philosophy, and culinary mastery.
Our gastronomic meal of the French is UNESCO-recognized heritage, celebrating wine terroir pairings, artisanal cheeses, and philosophical debate.

greenFlags: ✓ Refined palate for wine & cheese terroir
redFlags: ✗ Uncompromising stance on baguette crust crispness
✗ Sighs dramatically when asked for tap water

B2.opener: Bonjour! To what extent does cultural heritage shape your daily philosophical outlook and culinary preferences?
icebreakers: I admire the Parisian art de vivre!
B2.prompt: Analyze Camille's representation of French cultural heritage, 'art de vivre', and gastronomic philosophy.

B2.title: Leandro (Brazilian 🇧🇷)
B2.visualDescription: Sun-kissed Brazilian man playing beach volleyball on Ipanema Beach in Rio de Janeiro.

pages.bio: Olá! I'm Leandro from Rio de Janeiro. Brazilian nationality represents a vibrant melting pot of Indigenous, African, and European cultural influences.
From Carnival rhythms to Bossa Nova nostalgia and Sunday feijoada feasts, our culture thrives on spontaneous warmth, optimism, and communal joy.

greenFlags: ✓ Infectious warmth and open-hearted social energy
✓ Plays guitar and sings bossa nova by the bonfire
redFlags: ✗ Time is an abstract construct (always late)
✗ Hugs and double-cheek kisses strangers immediately

B2.opener: Olá! How do you view the relationship between cultural diversity, musical expression, and national identity?
B2.prompt: Evaluate Leandro's description of Brazilian multicultural identity, musical heritage, and social ethos.
